extracted.intended_audience: policy makers, IP statisticians, researchers and analysts working on industrial design / intellectual property statistics
extracted.subtask_description: A collection of statistical indicators and tables used to measure industrial design application and registration activity worldwide (applications, registrations, flows, procedural metrics, Hague system data, and related per-capita/GDP normalizations). Intended to support analysis and comparison across offices, origins and sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: C1. Trend in industrial design applications worldwide, 2005–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of industrial design applications worldwide, showing absolute application counts and year-on-year growth rates for 2005–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: China’s 2017 data are not comparable with previous years because the IP office changed counting rules (from all applications received to only those with necessary fees paid). Because China accounts for the bulk of the global total, the 2017 worldwide application growth rate cannot be reported. World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 153 IP offices and include direct filings (Paris route) and Hague designations (where applicable). Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C2. Trend in application design counts worldwide, 2005–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of application design counts worldwide (number of designs contained in applications) and year-on-year growth rates, 2005–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: China’s 2017 data are not comparable (see C1). World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 153 IP offices; totals include design counts in Paris-route applications and designations received via the Hague System. See the glossary for the definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C3. Resident and non-resident application design counts worldwide, 2005–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series separating resident vs non-resident shares of application design counts worldwide for 2005–2019, with non-resident share (%) plotted alongside absolute counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 153 IP offices. Totals include design counts in Paris-route applications and Hague System designations. See glossary for the definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C4. Trend in industrial design registrations worldwide, 2005–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of industrial design registrations (registrations issued by national and regional offices) and year-on-year growth rates for 2005–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 154 IP offices. Totals include registrations resulting from Paris-route applications and Hague designations (where applicable). Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C5. Trend in registration design counts worldwide, 2005–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of registration design counts (number of designs contained in registrations) worldwide and growth rates, 2005–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 154 IP offices; totals include design counts in registrations issued by national/regional offices and Hague designations. See the glossary for the definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C6. Resident and non-resident registration design counts worldwide, 2005–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series separating resident vs non-resident shares of registration design counts worldwide for 2005–2019, with non-resident share (%) and absolute counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 154 IP offices. Totals include design counts in registrations issued by national/regional offices and Hague designations (where applicable). See glossary for the definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C7. Application design counts by income group, 2009 and 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of number of designs in applications, resident share, share of world total, and average growth for income groups (high-income, upper middle-income, lower middle-income, low-income) comparing 2009 and 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Totals by income group are WIPO estimates using data covering 153 IP offices. Income-group categorizations and office counts for each group are provided. EUIPO data allocated to high-income; some regional office data allocated as noted. See Data description section for income classification. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C8. Application design counts by region, 2009 and 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of number of designs in applications, resident share, share of world total, and average growth for geographical regions (Africa, Asia, Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, North America, Oceania) comparing 2009 and 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Totals by geographical region are WIPO estimates using data covering 153 IP offices. The number of offices per region is provided. See Data description section for regional classification. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C9. Trend in industrial design applications for the top five offices, 1883–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Long-run time series of application counts (by application year) for the top five IP offices selected based on 2019 totals, covering 1883–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: The decrease in applications at the IP office of China in 2017 is likely due to a change in counting rules (see C1). Data are based on numbers of applications filed; differences between single-design and multiple-design filing systems across offices are not taken into account. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C10. Application design counts for the top 20 offices, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of application design counts (resident vs non-resident) and non-resident share (%) for the top 20 IP offices in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C11. Contribution of resident and non-resident application design counts to total growth for the top 20 offices, 2018–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Chart showing total growth rate in application design counts for each of the top 20 offices, decomposed into contributions from resident and non-resident filings (2018–2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Example interpretation provided (e.g., U.S. total grew 5.7% with resident applicants contributing 0.3 percentage points). Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C12. Application design counts for offices of selected low- and middle-income countries, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts (resident vs non-resident) and non-resident share (%) for selected low- and middle-income country offices in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Selected offices span different regions and income groups; ARIPO and OAPI are regional organizations and are included. Where available, complete statistical tables are in the section appendix. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C13. Contribution of resident and non-resident application design counts to total growth for offices of selected low- and middle-income countries, 2018–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Chart showing total growth rates in design counts for selected low- and middle-income offices, decomposed into resident and non-resident contributions (2018–2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Example interpretation provided (e.g., Viet Nam total grew 30.3% with non-resident applicants contributing 20.7 percentage points). ARIPO and OAPI noted. Full tables provided elsewhere. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C14. Registration design counts for the top 20 offices, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of registration design counts (resident vs non-resident) and growth rates for the top 20 offices in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C15. Registration design counts for offices of selected low- and middle-income countries, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration design counts (resident vs non-resident) and growth rates for selected low- and middle-income country offices in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Selected offices come from different regions and income groups; ARIPO and OAPI included. Where available, full statistical tables in the section appendix. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C16. Equivalent application design counts by origin, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Map (or classification) showing equivalent application design counts by origin, using ranges (e.g., 100,000–1,500,000; 10,000–99,999; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Equivalent application design count includes resident applications and applications filed abroad. The origin is determined by the residence of the first named applicant. Applications filed at some regional offices are considered equivalent to multiple applications in member states of those offices. See glossary for full definition of equivalent application and design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C17. Equivalent application design counts for the top 20 origins, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of equivalent application design counts for the top 20 origins, with resident vs abroad (equivalent) breakdowns and growth rates for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: The origin is determined by the residence of the first named applicant. An application filed at a regional office is considered a resident filing if the applicant is resident in a member state; some regional filings are treated as equivalent multiple filings. See glossary. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C18. Application design counts for the top 20 origins, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Absolute application design counts for the top 20 origins in 2019, showing resident filings and filings abroad (absolute counts), plus growth rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Data are based on absolute counts (not equivalent counts). Origin determined by residence of first named applicant. Regional office filings treated as resident if applicant is resident of a member state. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C19. Application design counts for selected low- and middle-income origins, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts (resident vs abroad absolute counts) and growth rates for selected low- and middle-income origins in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Data are absolute counts, selections cover varied regions and income groups. Full tables available in the appendix where available. Origin is determined by residence of the first named applicant. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C20. Flows of non-resident application design counts for the top five origins and the top 10 offices of high-income economies, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Flows/matrix of non-resident application design counts showing origins (top five) directed to top 10 offices of high-income economies in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C21. Flows of non-resident application design counts for the top five origins and the top 10 offices of low- and middle-income economies, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Flows/matrix of non-resident application design counts showing top five origins and top 10 offices of low- and middle-income economies in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C22. Application design counts by Locarno class, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of application design counts across Locarno classes for 2019, showing shares (%) and example class labels (e.g., Furnishing, Clothing, Graphic symbols and logos, Packages and containers, Recording and communication equipment, Means of transport, Household goods).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Figures based on data from 112 IP offices. Data for several large offices (including China, Japan and the U.S.) are either not available or incomplete. See annex C for class numbers. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C23. Distribution of application design counts by the top three sectors for the top 10 offices, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Bar/stacked distribution showing the top three industry sectors (converted from Locarno classes using an OECD concordance) that account for application design counts for the top 10 offices in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: A concordance table produced by the OECD was used to convert 32 Locarno classes into 12 industry sectors (see annex C for definitions). Top three sectors and top 10 offices selected based on 2019 totals. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C24. Distribution of application design counts by the top three sectors for the top 10 origins, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of application design counts by top three industry sectors for the top 10 origins in 2019, using the OECD concordance from Locarno classes to industry sectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: OECD concordance used to map classes to 12 sectors (see annex C). Figures based on data from 112 IP offices; several large offices' data are incomplete or unavailable (e.g., China, Japan, U.S.). Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C25. Resident application design count per USD 100 billion of GDP for the top 20 origins, 2009 and 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Resident application design counts normalized per USD 100 billion of GDP for the top 20 origins, comparing 2009 and 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: GDP data are in constant 2017 US PPP dollars. Origins selected based on top application design counts and GDP data availability. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C26. Resident application design count per million population for the top 20 origins, 2009 and 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Resident application design counts normalized per million population for the top 20 origins, comparing 2009 and 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Origins selected based on top application design counts and population data availability. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C27. Trend in industrial design registrations in force worldwide, 2010–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of the number of industrial design registrations in force worldwide and year-on-year growth rates for 2010–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: WIPO estimates cover 122 IP offices and include direct national/regional applications as well as designations received via the Hague System. Data refer to number of registrations in force, not the number of designs contained in registrations in force. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C28. Industrial design registrations in force for the top 20 offices, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of the number of industrial design registrations in force by office (top 20 offices) for 2019, with growth rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Data refer to number of registrations in force (not number of designs contained). .. indicates not available. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C29. Industrial design registrations in force in 2019 as a percentage of total registrations
rubrics_metrics.description: For each registration year t, percentage of registrations that remain in force in 2019, plotted across registration years to show the share surviving to 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages calculated as number of industrial designs registered in year t and in force in 2019 divided by total number registered in year t. Based on data from 87 offices (including most large offices except Japan) for which breakdowns by year were available. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C30. Average age of industrial design registrations in force at selected offices, 2014 and 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Average age (in years) of registrations in force at selected offices, compared between 2014 and 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C31. Distribution of industrial design examination outcomes for selected offices, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution (percent) of examination outcomes for selected offices in 2019, categorized as Registered, Rejected, Withdrawn/Abandoned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: WIPO collects data using a common questionnaire and methodology, but differences in procedures across offices mean data cannot be fully harmonized; exercise caution when comparing across offices. EUIPO label used where relevant. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C32. Potentially pending applications for selected offices, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of potentially pending industrial design applications for selected offices in 2019 (absolute numbers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: WIPO collects data using a common questionnaire and methodology; differences in procedures across offices prevent full harmonization—use caution for cross-office comparisons. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C33. Average pendency times from filing date to first office action and to final decision at selected offices, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Average pendency days for (a) filing date to first office action and (b) filing date to final decision for selected offices in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: WIPO collects these data via a common questionnaire; procedural differences across offices limit harmonization—exercise caution comparing offices. EUIPO label used where relevant. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C34. Number of industrial design examiners for selected offices, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of industrial design examiners (equivalent full-time) at selected IP offices in 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office and OAPI is the African Intellectual Property Organization. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C35. Trend in designs contained in Hague international applications, 2005–2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of number of designs contained in Hague international applications and year-on-year growth rates for 2005–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C36. Designs contained in Hague international applications by origin, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Map/classification of numbers of designs in Hague international applications by origin for 2019 using ranges (e.g., 1,000–5,000; 200–999; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Applicants residing in a non-member country can still file if they have a real and effective industrial or commercial establishment within a Hague member jurisdiction. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C37. Designs contained in Hague international applications for the top 20 origins, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of number of designs contained in Hague international applications for the top 20 origins in 2019, with growth rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C38. Designs contained in designations in Hague international applications for the top 20 designated Hague members, 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of designs contained in designations (i.e., designated Hague members) in Hague international applications for the top 20 designated members in 2019, with growth rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: .. indicates not available. Example: European Union, Switzerland, Turkey, U.S., U.K., Norway, etc., shown. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.

rubrics_metrics.name: C39. Industrial design applications by office and origin, 2019 (statistical table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive statistical table listing industrial design application counts by filing office and by origin for 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the detailed data tables that underpin the charts and summary figures in this section. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2020.
